시편-134-3.title: 시편 134장 3절 역사문법적 주해
시편-134-3.exegesis: PSALM 134 Psa 134:1-3. 1 , 2. The pilgrim bands arriving at the sanctuary call on the priests, who stand in the house of the Lord-- at the time of the evening sacrifice, to unite in praising God in their name and that of the people, using appropriate gestures, to which the priests reply, pronouncing the Mosaic blessing which they alone could pronounce. A fit epilogue to the whole pilgrim-book, Psalms 120-134. by night-- the evening service ( Psa 141:2 ), as opposed to morning ( Psa 92:2 ). 2. Lift up your hands-- (Compare Psa 28:2 ).
